Executive Summary

Bridging Design Precision, Enterprise Scalability, and AI Ingestion Engineering

Over the past decade, I have led and delivered complex web applications, high-throughput data ingestion tools for AI/LLM model training, and corporate automation systems across multinational teams in North America, Europe, and Latin America.

My dual focus combines rigorous Front-End Architecture (React, Angular, TypeScript) with specialized expertise in data collection tools (SurveyJS), output sanitization, and enterprise workflow orchestration (Microsoft Power Platform).
